description: This Scala source file defines the 'NameStreamingSources' rule for Apache Spark SQL's catalyst optimizer. It propagates source identifying names in streaming relations during query analysis, enforces naming rules, and handles streaming source resolution.

classes.name: NameStreamingSources
classes.description: A rule that propagates source names in streaming relations during query analysis, ensuring proper source identification and enforcement of naming rules.

methods.name: getSourceDescriptor
methods.description: Returns a string descriptor for a streaming source, used in error messages.

methods.name: checkSourceNamingEnforcement
methods.description: Checks that all streaming sources are explicitly named when enforcement is enabled; throws an error if unnamed sources are found.

methods.name: propagateSourceNames
methods.description: Unwraps NamedStreamingRelation nodes and propagates their source names to underlying streaming relations.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Main method that applies the rule to a LogicalPlan, performing naming enforcement and propagation if the plan is streaming.
